items.title: Greg Caputo interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 14, 1998
items.q: He has performed with Sammy Davis Jr., Claude Williams, Benny Waters, The Benny Goodman Sextet, The Artie Shaw Big Band, and in numerous show bands.

ctx.x: Drummer Greg Caputo places great emphasis on being versatile in today’s music scene. He decided on a life in music at an early age and counts both his father and drummer Joe Morello as major influences on his career. He has performed with Sammy Davis Jr., Claude Williams, Benny Waters, The Benny Goodman Sextet, The Artie Shaw Big Band, and in numerous show bands. Greg frequently presents clinics for percussion students and will tour Europe in the summer of ‘98 with a jazz group from the University of Massachusetts.
Greg was interviewed in Clinton, New York on March 14, 1998, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
